item.title: Ashes 2025-26: WATCH- Michael Vaughan, Ricky Ponting and crowd tip their hats to honor Shane Warne’s memory at MCG
item.description: Shane Warne's memory and legacy have loomed heavily over the ongoing fourth Ashes 2025-26 Test at the Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG) since his tragic demise. Shane Warne, considered one of the greatest spinners in cricket history, passed away on March 4, 2022, in Thailand, while on vacation. Shane Warne, who made his Test debut in 1992, went on to become the first bowler to take 700 wickets in Tests.
